products.baseName: Meri Meri x John Derian Xmas Garland Set, 1.8m, Multi
products.variantName: Meri Meri x John Derian Xmas Garland Set, 1.8m, Multi
products.sourceDescription:
Meri Meri has collaborated with renowned New York–based artist and designer John Derian on a winter collection infused with magic and seasonal charm.

This set of Christmas garlands creates a wonderland of foliage, flowers, birds and mushrooms, along with a “Merry Christmas” message. Crepe paper, gold foil, tissue paper, glitter and wooden beads combine to make opulent decorations. Hang them together for a statement effect or separately to spread the joy throughout your home. Pack away after the celebrations and bring out year after year for a beautiful display in your home. Length is 1.8 metres.

Founded in 1989, the John Derian Company is celebrated for its handcrafted decoupage, created by artisans in its New York City studios. Derian began his career with a small collection of handmade plates, building a practice that blends historical illustration with a modern, whimsical sensibility.

Derian's work has since expanded to collaborations with international brands across stationery, ceramics and furniture, and is sold at his Manhattan stores and select boutiques worldwide. The John Derian Picture Book, published in 2016, became a New York Times bestseller, followed by Picture Book II.

products.baseName: Sara Miller Woodland Tales Porcelain 22ct Gold Christmas Tree Decorations, Set of 3, Multi
products.variantName: Sara Miller Woodland Tales Porcelain 22ct Gold Christmas Tree Decorations, Set of 3, Multi
products.sourceDescription:
Bring the magic of a winter wonderland to your festive decor with this enchanting trio of Christmas decorations from the Sara Miller London Portmeirion Woodland Tales collection. Each disc-shaped ornament features a heartwarming scene of playful bunnies celebrating the season in a whimsical woodland setting. Hang up the ornaments using the included ribbons.
A wonderful gift-boxed present for someone special, made of porcelain with 22-carat gold detailing.
Choose the perfect china
 All our china is made from clay and kiln-fired for durability. Except for pieces with special trims, everything is dishwasher-safe. Below are a few options to consider when choosing your perfect china. EarthenwareStrong and practical, earthenware is often a little thicker than other ceramics, making it ideal for everyday use. StonewareFired at high temperatures, stoneware is very tough and heat-resistant. It comes in a number of different glaze finishes. PorcelainAffordable yet luxurious, porcelain is renowned for its translucency. Fired at high temperatures, porcelain has an extremely tough glazed surface, making it durable. Fine china The synthetic bone ash used in fine china makes it a more affordable alternative to bone china. Like bone china, it's strong, translucent and delicate, and creamier in colour. New bone china A type of porcelain with added calcium oxide to achieve a similar aesthetic as bone china, but without animal bone ash. Bone china White bone china is the strongest and most translucent ceramic. Though it looks delicate, it's tough enough for daily use and is usually dishwasher-safe. It contains at least 35% bone ash.

products.baseName: Wedgwood Dove Jasperware Christmas Ornament, Blue
products.variantName: Wedgwood Dove Jasperware Christmas Ornament, Blue
products.sourceDescription:
Crafted by hand in Barlaston, England, this Jasperware tree decoration highlights a graceful dove, a timeless emblem of harmony, compassion and unity. Comes with a red jacquard ribbon. Presented in beautiful gift packaging.

Celebrate cherished festive traditions with Jasperware Christmas Ornaments, beautifully crafted to showcase the artistry and heritage that define Wedgwood. From elegant Jasperware Christmas decorations to collectible keepsakes designed to return to the tree year after year, each piece captures the enduring appeal of this iconic material.

Perfected by Josiah Wedgwood in 1774, Jasperware remains one of the most iconic materials in the history of ceramics. Exclusively handcrafted in England, its tactile matt finish and distinctive character have made it synonymous with Wedgwood.

products.variantName: Ichendorf Milano Christmas Tales Elf Glass Bauble, Blue
products.sourceDescription:
In the heart of the Christmas Village, the elves work tirelessly among mountains of gifts, spiced biscuits and colored ribbons. They are the protagonists of this cheerful and fanciful Christmas Tales collection: little helpers peeping out from bottles, jugs and glasses, guarding teapots and boxes like precious treasures.
Alongside them appear gift packages, butter biscuits, sweet gingerbread, candies and decorations that evoke the scents and warmth of the festive season. Each creation is evocative moments of Christmas preparations: wrapping gifts, taking freshly fragrant biscuits out of the oven, decorating the house and waiting with excitement for the arrival of the most magical night of the year.
Handmade and flame-worked borosilicate glass, the Christmas Tales collection is designed by Alessandra Baldereschi and includes this elf with candy cane bauble.

products.baseName: Georg Jensen Christmas Collectibles 2026 Mini Mobiles Tree Decorations, Set of 3, Gold
products.variantName: Georg Jensen Christmas Collectibles 2026 Mini Mobiles Tree Decorations, Set of 3, Gold
products.sourceDescription:
This trio of 18-carat gold-plated mobiles, originally created in the late eighties and early nineties, is now reissued in a miniature size, making them true collector's pieces. The series includes the 1988 'Holly' by Lene Munthe, shaped by the distinctive form of its leaves; the 1989 'Angel' by celebrated Danish designer Nanna Ditzel; and Jette Frölich’s 1992 Christmas mobile featuring a braided heart and flying birds, a symbol of freedom.

Each piece features classic festive motifs and hangs from a striking red ribbon, adding a touch of tradition to any Christmas tree.

products.baseName: Georg Jensen Christmas Collectibles 2026 Drum Mobile Tree Decoration, Gold
products.variantName: Georg Jensen Christmas Collectibles 2026 Drum Mobile Tree Decoration, Gold
products.sourceDescription:
The 2026 edition of Georg Jensen’s annual Christmas mobile is the defining piece of this year's musical Christmas theme, expressed through a collection inspired by the music and melodies so closely connected to the holiday season.

The mobile takes the form of a drum wrapped in a swirling band of musical notes, drawing inspiration from the beloved Danish Christmas song 'Højt fra træets grønne top' ('High on the Tree’s Green Top'), written by Peter Faber in 1847 and traditionally sung in Denmark on Christmas Eve as families gather around the tree. Lyrics from the song are also engraved in the gold-plated ribbon that surrounds the drum.

The mobile is plated in 18-carat gold and comes with a sleek ribbon in two colours: classic red and a deep red created especially for Georg Jensen's 2026 Christmas Collectibles.

products.sourceDescription:
Deck your halls with the annual assortment of wildly collectible Menagerie ornaments from Jonathan Adler, including this capybaba. Handcrafted from high-fired porcelain in a smooth matt finish with a satin ribbon tie, each piece pops against your evergreen trees and wreaths. Simple to set up, the hinged branches drop easily into place requiring a small amount of "tweaking" to create the fullest effect. The tree comes in slot-together sections and sits on a metal stand.

Benefits of LEDs:

Energy efficient

Consume up to 90% less power than incandescent bulbs

Long LED lifespan

Extremely durable and built with sturdy components

products.baseName: John Lewis Aylesford Super Pre-Lit Christmas Tree, 7ft, Green
products.variantName: John Lewis Aylesford Super Pre-Lit Christmas Tree, 7ft, Green
products.sourceDescription:
Our artificial Christmas tree is pre-lit with multi-function micro LEDs. Crafted in a rich, emerald-green colour, with a soft, irregular outline that permits longer tree trims to hang freely, whilst more compact decorations can nestle neatly between the branches.

The small, decorative light bulbs give your tree or room a wonderful sparkle with a softer light output to create atmosphere, with a timer that automatically switches the lights on at the same time each day and off after 8 hours.

Benefits of Micro LEDs:

Energy efficient

Consume up to 90% less power than incandescent bulbs

Long LED lifespan

Micro LED lighting uses "bare look wire", which gives a pleasing "shape" to your Christmas tree

products.variantName: John Lewis Brompton Pre-lit Christmas Tree, 6ft, Green
products.sourceDescription:
A bushy, classically conical artificial Christmas tree, pre-lit with pure white LEDs.

The tree's tips are accurately moulded and coloured to mimic a real spruce tree. A rich, emerald-green colour, the tree's outline is a bit more structured for a slightly neater silhouette.

Simple to set up, the hinged branches drop easily into place requiring a small amount of 'tweaking' to create the fullest effect. Tree comes in three, slot-together sections and a metal stand is included.

Benefits of LEDs:

Energy efficient

Consume up to 90% less power than incandescent bulbs

Long LED lifespan

Extremely durable and built with sturdy components

With a timer that automatically switches the lights on at the same time each day and off after 8 hours.

Functions:

Steady on

In waves

Sequential

Slo-glo

Chasing/Fade

Slow fade

Twinkle/flash

Combination

products.variantName: John Lewis Skye Pre-lit Christmas Tree, Snowy, 7ft
products.sourceDescription:
A naturally-shaped artificial Christmas tree, pre-lit with 550 warm white multifunction micro LEDs. The tree's outer tips are frosted with lifelike "snow" making the perfect background to brightly-coloured baubles and other tree decorations.

This tree is fitted with a timer that automatically switches the lights on at the same time each day and off after 8 hours.

Simple to set up, the hinged branches drop easily into place requiring a small amount of "tweaking" to create the fullest effect. The tree comes in slot-together sections and sits on a metal stand.

The small, decorative light bulbs give your tree or room a wonderful sparkle with a softer light output to create atmosphere.

Benefits of Micro LEDs:

Energy efficient

Consume up to 90% less power than incandescent bulbs

Long LED lifespan

Micro LED lighting uses "bare look wire", which gives a pleasing "shape" to your Christmas tree

products.baseName: John Lewis St. Petersburg Pre-lit Christmas Tree, 7ft, Green
products.variantName: John Lewis St. Petersburg Pre-lit Christmas Tree, 7ft, Green
products.sourceDescription:
A full, classically conical artificial Christmas tree pre-lit with pure white LEDs with 8 different functions. A timer automatically switches the lights on at the same time each day and off after 8 hours and the broad base gives it dramatic impact when set up.

The trees' outer tips are accurately moulded and coloured to mimic a real spruce tree, while bushier PVC branches sit closer to the trunk for extra fullness. A rich, emerald-green colour, the outermost tips are a lighter green to resemble new growth. A soft, irregular outline permits longer tree trims to hang freely, whilst more compact decorations nestle neatly between the branches.

Simple to set up, the hinged branches drop easily into place requiring a small amount of 'tweaking' to create the fullest effect. Tree comes in three, slot-together sections and a metal stand is included.

Functions:

Steady on

In waves

Sequential

Slo-glo

Chasing/Fade

Slow fade

Twinkle/flash

Combination

Benefits of Micro LEDs:

Energy efficient

Consume up to 90% less power than incandescent bulbs

Long LED lifespan

Micro LED lighting uses "bare look wire", which gives a pleasing "shape" to your Christmas tree

A compact, slimline artificial Christmas tree, pre-lit with warm white static LEDs.

The tree's outer tips are fine needles in a dark, forest green colour, designed to mimic trees found in deep forest areas. This dark colouring will help the colours of your baubles and decorations really pop./p>

The slim, structured outline is ideal for entryways or small rooms.

Simple to set up, the hinged branches drop easily into place requiring a small amount of "tweaking" to create the fullest effect. The tree comes in slot-together sections and sits in a stone effect pot.

Energy efficient

Consume up to 90% less power than incandescent bulbs

Long LED lifespan

Extremely durable and built with sturdy components

products.baseName: John Lewis Brunswick Spruce Unlit Christmas Tree, 5ft
products.variantName: John Lewis Brunswick Spruce Unlit Christmas Tree, 5ft
products.sourceDescription:
A bushy, classically conical artificial Christmas tree. The tree's outer tips are accurately moulded and coloured to mimic a real spruce tree.

A rich, emerald-green colour, the outermost tips are a lighter green to resemble new growth. A soft, irregular outline permits longer tree trims to hang freely, whilst more compact decorations nestle neatly between the branches.

Simple to set up, the hinged branches drop easily into place, requiring a small amount of 'tweaking' to create the fullest effect. The tree comes in three, slot-together sections, and a metal stand is included.

products.baseName: nkuku Adiela Wreath, Green
products.variantName: nkuku Adiela Wreath, Green
products.sourceDescription:
The Adiela wreath captures the quiet beauty of winter woodland. A soft blend of mossy greens and silvery greys creates an organic, asymmetrical base, while sculptural thistles add a hint of wild elegance. Inspired by the textures and tones of a walk through the woods, it brings a rustic, natural charm to seasonal decorating, perfect for hanging on doors, mantels, or walls.

The base of the wreath is handcrafted using panchu sticks, mixed with natural bark and plant skin fibres to achieve both strength and texture. Each stick is carefully wound into a circular form to create a sturdy foundation. The greenery and thistles are then artfully arranged by hand, giving every wreath a unique, naturally sculpted appearance.

This elegant arch includes a built-in 8-hour timer that allows you to set it and forget it, providing beautiful illumination every evening. With its inviting glow and impressive size, it's perfect for creating a stunning centrepiece in a garden or as a grand welcome by a front door.

Long LED lifespan

These enchanting Kiko box decorations are waiting to be filled with gifts for the tree. The brass has an aged antique hue which pairs beautifully with the recycled glass windows.

Not limited to the tree, these exquisite boxes make a unique and luxurious gift packaging idea for jewellery and other small ornaments. Each Sari tie is one of a kind, so the piece you receive will vary slightly from the images shown, due to its individual character and handcrafted nature.

products.variantName: John Lewis Chunky Tinsel, Matt Green, L2m
products.sourceDescription:
Featuring a stylish mix of chunky dark aglan and fine light aglan strands, the layered tones of this tinsel create a rich, textured look that adds depth and sophistication to any setting. Perfect for wrapping around larger trees, dressing banisters, or enhancing display areas, this full-bodied tinsel is both striking and versatile. Reusable and easy to work with, it's a chic way to elevate your Christmas decorations with a contemporary edge.

This tinsel is made in Cwmbran in Wales, the only place in the UK where tinsel is made. The short journey from the factory to our shops helps keep it fluffy.

Many of the colours and finishes are exclusive to John Lewis & Partners.
